source.snippet: Claude Code like agentic workflow ai too costly for me. Any LLM can I run with VSCode at the below setup? 16ram, Intel core i7 h processor 13gen, 512gb NVMe SSD. I want to run the ai as local agentic workflow with Vscode. I have tried Gemma3 270M, Qwen3.5 4bit, they are fast but less coding focused.

problem_statement: Developers who want AI-assisted agentic coding workflows (à la Claude Code / Cursor) find cloud-API costs prohibitive but cannot find a local LLM that matches the coding quality of hosted models on modest consumer hardware, leaving them stuck between unaffordable cloud and underperforming local alternatives.
target_segment: Independent developers, freelancers, and students running mid-range laptops (no discrete GPU) who use or want VS Code-based AI coding agents but cannot absorb $20-100+/month API costs.
notes: Explicit cost-pain signal: user names Claude Code by price as the reason for seeking alternatives. Paying-buyer evidence: they were paying or seriously evaluating paid cloud APIs. Opportunity angles: (1) a curated guide/toolchain service for CPU-only agentic coding setups with ongoing updates (subscription); (2) a lightweight proxy/router that falls back from cloud to local model when token budget is hit. Adjacent demand visible in prior batches around LLM cost optimisation.
